priorities.finding: Current leaf call hashes every mixed-height column at maximum tree height; source-row lifting repeats small-table hashing. Existing progressive seed interface permits absorbing sorted prefixes at native height then lifting states, preserving exact leaf roots. Benefit and scratch cost remain unmeasured.

priorities.item: Parallelize DEEP validation and line preparation
priorities.finding: Validation uses one thread over all terms. Line preparation uses one thread per group, only68 threads here, and computes alpha powers independently per term. Preserve exact field order/term powers and adversarial metadata checks.
Helper wall far exceeds224ms GPU work. Connect resident context and coefficients directly to the production process before interpreting GPU stage time as a prover result.
Coefficient aggregation already precedes LDE. No per-column quotient re-expansion exists to remove.
